# A01 report: Scout

Branch `v2-a01-scout`. Everything in my brief is built and committed; the
acceptance list at the end says honestly where it falls short.

## What I built

### Connectors (`server/sources/`), 33 in total

- **All 16 v1 connectors kept** (same ids, so saved enable switches still work),
  now on a polite transport and setting `applyUrl` where they know it (RemoteOK
  `apply_url`, Himalayas `applicationLink`, SimplifyJobs direct ATS links, ATS
  links found inside HN and Reddit hiring posts). Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby
  set `ats`, `applyUrl` and `companyDomain`, poll registry boards as well as the
  settings boards, and Lever/Greenhouse handle EU tenants.
- **11 new per-company ATS connectors** (`atsMore.ts`): SmartRecruiters, Workday
  (CXS search POST + detail), Workable, Recruitee, Personio (XML), Teamtailor
  (RSS), BambooHR, Breezy, JazzHR (XML export), Rippling and Pinpoint. That makes
  **14 ATS families polled**, all verified live on 2026-11-02 and documented in
  `docs/SOURCES.md` §17. For ATSs whose list has no description, details are
  fetched only for tech titles that aren't stored yet, within a per-board and
  per-run budget, so repeat runs continue where the last one stopped.
- **Detection-only families**: Comeet, iCIMS, Taleo, SuccessFactors, Oracle
  Cloud HCM, Jobvite, Eightfold. Apply URLs still resolve to them and the
  registry records them (`unsupported`), but they aren't polled (see Known limits).
- **JobSpy sidecar** (`sidecars/jobspy/`, `server/scout/jobspy.ts`,
  `server/sources/jobspy.ts`): a Python CLI around python-jobspy 1.4.1 (guest
  search on LinkedIn, Indeed, Glassdoor, Google, ZipRecruiter, Bayt, Naukri), a
  TS client that spawns the venv's Python, sends JSON on stdin, enforces a
  timeout and parses the result. Search terms rotate through roles × locations
  (4 per run, persisted cursor); per-site failures come back as errors without
  sinking the others; proxies come from settings. When Python or the venv is
  missing the source reports `unavailable` and the scan continues.
  `scripts/setup-sidecar.ps1` and `scripts/setup-sidecar.sh` create the venv.
- **Local boards** (`local.ts`): Rozee.pk (search pages embed JSON) and Mustakbil
  (category pages), both robots.txt-checked and paced. GulfTalent (Cloudflare
  challenge) and NaukriGulf (unreachable) were checked and are documented as not
  usable; Bayt comes through JobSpy.
- **Niche boards** (`niche.ts`): 4dayweek.io, Python.org jobs, and Y Combinator
  (HN job stories via the official API plus Work at a Startup's public pages).
  Wellfound (Turnstile) and landing.jobs (robots.txt disallows `/api/`) were
  checked and left out.
- **Polite transport** (`sources/http.ts`): per-host concurrency and spacing,
  robots.txt for every scraped page (longest-match rules, `Crawl-delay`,
  unreachable robots → don't fetch), and a swappable transport so selfcheck runs
  every connector offline against recorded payloads.

### Scout pipeline (`server/scout/`)

- `index.ts` → **`runScout(opts)`** (same name and signature as the stub) and
  `scoutPipeline()` for the full report. Connectors run 6 at a time, each with a
  timeout; a second call while a run is in flight joins it. Steps: run →
  **resolve** aggregator links to the employer's ATS (`resolve.ts`: HTTP only via
  `safeFetch`, robots-checked, budget + deadline, never fetches LinkedIn/Indeed
  guest pages) → **normalise** (`normalize.ts`: salary parsing and annualisation,
  remote / hybrid / onsite, visa mentions, seniority, relative dates) →
  **dedupe** → **ghost/scam filter** → **freshness priority** → insert with
  `apply_url_canonical`, `ats`, `company_id`, `legitimacy`, `sources`,
  `priority` → `ensurePipeline(jobId, campaignId)` for every new job (which emits
  `pipeline.state → found`). Campaign config (roles, categories, locations,
  max age, per-source overrides, `deepscan`) is read when `campaignId` is given.
- **Dedupe** (`ingest.ts`): canonical apply URL (ATS URLs rewritten to their
  shortest working form) → the v1 fingerprint (company + title) plus a soft key
  (company id + normalised title tokens) → **embeddings** from
  `server/ai/embed.ts` stored in `job_embeddings` with the model name and only
  compared within one model; cosine ≥ 0.92 within the same company *and*
  compatible titles (token Jaccard ≥ 0.5). The richest record wins, missing fields
  are filled from the others, and every source is linked in `jobs.sources`.
  Placeholder employers ("Unknown", "Confidential") never merge.
- **Legitimacy** (`legitimacy.ts`): scam = payment requests or easy-money/crypto
  bait (anti-scam disclaimers like "we will never ask you to pay a fee" are
  recognised and ignored; an employer's own ATS posting is downgraded to
  `suspect`); ghost = past max age, reposted 3+ times, evergreen talent pools, no
  apply route; suspect = personal email only, no company, near-empty text.
  Nothing is deleted. Existing rows that age out are swept to `ghost`.
- **Priority**: +2 posted within 48 h (`freshHours`), +1 company with a hiring
  signal in the last 14 days.
- **Company registry** (`registry.ts`, `detect.ts`, `seed-companies.json`):
  ATS auto-detection from URLs and DOM fingerprints for 19 families, seeded with
  **3,495 companies** (v1 boards, every SOURCES.md token, verified tokens, and
  every ATS board in the SimplifyJobs new-grad list). It grows from every apply
  URL seen anywhere (connectors, resolver, HN/Reddit, SimplifyJobs, deep scan),
  and `discovery.ts` adds a weekly Claude `site:` search per ATS aimed at the
  campaign's categories. Boards are polled oldest-first within a per-family
  budget; 404 boards are marked `dead`.
- **Hiring signals** (`signals.ts`, bookkeeping in the registry): a ≥30% jump in
  open roles between polls, or funding news mined from deep-scan research text.
  Signal companies are polled first every cycle and their roles get +1 priority.
- **Deep scan**: kept; `runScout` runs it when a campaign enables `deepscan` (or
  `sources: ['deepscan']`), feeding it the campaign's roles. I added an optional,
  backwards-compatible `onResearch` hook to `deepScan()` in `server/ai/scout.ts`
  so its research text and sources feed registry discovery and funding signals.
- **Per-source health** (`health.ts`): ok / slow / failing / unavailable /
  disabled / idle, last error, found / added / dupes, timing, boards ok/failed,
  persisted across restarts.
- **v1 compatibility**: `server/services/scanner.ts` now delegates the
  sources scan to `scoutPipeline()` (the v1 buttons and v1 hunt keep working and
  keep their own `scans` row and scoring step), and `ingest()` (manual capture,
  deep scan) is a thin adapter over the scout's synchronous ingest, so those jobs
  get the new columns and enter the pipeline too.

### Routes (`server/scout/routes.ts`, all under `/api/scout`)

| Method | Path | What |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/api/scout/health` | per-source health, JobSpy sidecar status, last-run summary, running flag |
| GET | `/api/scout/stats` | last run report (dedupe stats, per-connector outcomes, resolver, registry) + registry stats |
| POST | `/api/scout/run` | start a run `{ sources?, campaignId? }` (joins a running one), rate-limited |
| GET | `/api/scout/companies` | registry list/search `?q=&ats=&status=&signals=1&limit=&offset=` |
| GET | `/api/scout/companies/:id` | one company |
| POST | `/api/scout/companies` | add a company by careers URL or domain `{ url, name? }`, ATS detected from the URL, else from the page DOM |
| PATCH | `/api/scout/companies/:id` | `{ status: 'active' \| 'paused' }` |
| POST | `/api/scout/detect` | `{ url }` → detected ATS, token, job id, canonical apply URL (no network) |
| GET | `/api/scout/signals` | companies with fresh hiring signals |
| GET / PUT | `/api/scout/settings` | scout tuning (budgets, threshold, JobSpy sites/terms/proxies, discovery switch) |
| POST | `/api/scout/registry/seed` | re-run the registry seed `{ force? }` |

## How to run and test

- Offline tests: `npm run selfcheck -- a01` (57 checks, about 15 s): ATS
  detection on 43 URL samples (38 positive), canonical URLs, DOM fingerprints,
  robots.txt rules, **every connector's parser against its recorded payload** in
  `fixtures/feeds/<connector>-*`, field spot checks, normalisation, the 3-source
  dedupe collapse, the embedding layer, placeholder employers, the
  ghost/scam filter, the v1 `ingest()` adapter, registry seed/discovery/signals,
  add-by-careers-URL (URL and DOM paths), the resolver, weekly discovery with an
  injected search, **JobSpy with no Python**, an offline end-to-end `runScout`
  with health, and the `/api/scout/*` routes through Fastify `inject`.
- `npm run typecheck` and the full `npm run selfcheck` pass in the worktree.
- JobSpy: `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/setup-sidecar.ps1`
  (Windows) or `bash scripts/setup-sidecar.sh`. Then
  `cd sidecars/jobspy && .venv/Scripts/python -m jobspy_cli --check`.
- A live run: start Bureau and `POST /api/scout/run`, or press "Scan sources"
  in the v1 UI (it now goes through the scout pipeline). Watch
  `GET /api/scout/health` and `GET /api/scout/stats`.

## Live run on a seeded registry

One full `scoutPipeline()` run on 2026-11-02 against live sources, with a
temporary `BUREAU_DATA_DIR` outside the repo, the default settings (32 enabled
sources; SimplifyJobs is off by default), the registry auto-seeded with 3,495
companies, no profile (so the default categories web / security / mobile / game
and no campaign roles), max age 30 days, and the real MiniLM embedding model
(downloaded on first use). Wall time **631 s** on this connection.

**Result: 5,619 unique tech postings inserted** (all 5,619 entered the pipeline at
`found`, each with a MiniLM vector in `job_embeddings`). That's one run, and it
polls only part of the registry: each ATS family is capped per run (150 boards,
60 for Workday, 120 for SmartRecruiters, 600 detail requests per connector), so
the next 2-hourly runs work through the rest of the boards. "Relevant" here means
"a tech role" (the v1 classifier plus my engineering-discipline gate), not
"matches a candidate", since no profile was loaded.

Dedupe stats as logged by the run:

```
Dedupe: 46898 received · 0 invalid · 28852 stale · 10872 not tech · 1109 in-run duplicates (url 337, fingerprint 772) ·
        45 already known (url 0, fingerprint 45) · 401 embedding duplicates · 5619 new unique
        (510 under 48h, 4517 with employer ATS link; ghost 73, scam 3, suspect 190)
Registry: 1151 boards polled, 67 new boards discovered, 0 hiring signals · resolver 2/150 · 5619 unique postings in the last 24h
```

- 28,852 postings were older than 30 days. ATS boards list everything that's open,
  including long-running requisitions.
- 80% of the new jobs (4,517) carry the employer's own ATS apply URL.
- No hiring signals on a first run is expected: a signal needs two polls of the
  same board.
- The resolver only turned 2 of 150 aggregator links into ATS URLs, because the
  first aggregators to finish (RemoteOK, Remotive) spent the whole run budget on
  pages that load their apply link with JavaScript. I then split the budget per
  source (25 each, reserved up front). A follow-up live run of seven aggregators
  resolved 18 links, 16 of them from 4dayweek; Himalayas, WWR and Jobicy pages
  still yield little.

tech roles (Stripe, MongoDB, Riot, Shield AI, Cursor…); the v1 classifier still
lets a few product-manager titles through.

An earlier smoke run of ten of the new connectors (SmartRecruiters, Personio,
Teamtailor, Breezy, JazzHR, Pinpoint, BambooHR, Recruitee, 4dayweek, Python.org)
on its own data dir inserted 1,864 jobs. It also showed 18 false "scam" flags from
an anti-scam disclaimer ("candidates never pay a fee"), which I fixed before the
full run (disclaimer-aware matching; ATS postings capped at `suspect`). The full
run had 3 scam flags.

## Known limits

- **Comeet** positions need a per-company token embedded in its careers page;
  I didn't build token extraction (it looked like lifting credentials out of a
  page, and the permission system flagged it), so Comeet is detection only.
  **iCIMS** answers with a human-verification page; Taleo, SuccessFactors and
  Oracle HCM have no simple public JSON. All are detection only.
- **GulfTalent, NaukriGulf, Wellfound** aren't used (bot challenges or
  unreachable); Bayt only through JobSpy.
- **Linux**: the TS client handles `.venv/bin/python3`, and `setup-sidecar.sh`
  is syntax-checked and executable, but I couldn't run it on a real Linux host
  here. The Windows path is verified end to end (Python 3.13 chosen
  automatically; 3.14 is also present).
- **Per-source health in `/api/sources`**: that route is A10's, so health is at
  `/api/scout/health`; the one-line merge is in `docs/build/requests/A01.md`.
- `safeFetch` has no POST yet, so `sources/http.ts` has a small guarded POST
  adapter for Workday (request in `docs/build/requests/A01.md`).
- Postings older than the max age are dropped at ingest (counted as `stale`)
  rather than inserted as `ghost`; rows that age out later are marked `ghost`.
- The v1 classifier files every "…Engineer" title under `software`; I added a
  relevance gate that drops civil/mechanical/process-type engineering unless the
  title also names software work. It's a heuristic and errs toward keeping.
- The 0.92 embedding threshold is the brief's number; with MiniLM I added the
  title-compatibility guard because shared company boilerplate pushes unrelated
  roles at one company close together. Not tuned on a labelled set.
- Deep scan and the weekly Claude discovery were tested offline only (no API key
  in this environment).
- Legitimacy reasons are logged but not stored (column requested).

## Follow-ups

- Merge `sourceHealth()` into `/api/sources` (A10) and add a registry view to the
  Sources page (`/api/scout/companies`, add-by-URL, pause).
- Comeet support if the owner is comfortable with reading the public token from
  the careers page; an iCIMS path only if a public JSON endpoint turns up.
- Calibrate the embedding threshold on a few hundred labelled duplicate pairs from
  real runs.
- Improve resolver yield on Himalayas / WWR / Jobicy pages (their apply links are behind JavaScript or redirects that aren't ATS).
- Bump `boardsPerRun` once the registry's dead boards have been weeded out by a
  few cycles (first runs spend part of the budget on boards that 404).

## Acceptance

- ✅ **12+ ATS families supported, each verified live and documented**: 14
  polled (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, SmartRecruiters, Workday, Workable,
  Recruitee, Personio, Teamtailor, BambooHR, Breezy, JazzHR, Rippling, Pinpoint),
  all verified live on 2026-11-02, documented in `docs/SOURCES.md` §1–3 and §17,
  each with a recorded fixture and a parser test. Comeet, iCIMS, Taleo,
  SuccessFactors and Oracle HCM are detected but not polled (reasons above).
- ⚠️ **The JobSpy sidecar works on Windows and Linux, and degrades gracefully**:
  verified on Windows (setup script, `--check`, live Indeed + LinkedIn search, and
  412 postings in the full run). The missing-Python path is tested in selfcheck
  and reports `unavailable` while the scan continues. Linux is written for
  (`setup-sidecar.sh`, `.venv/bin/python3`) but not run on a Linux host.
- ✅ **The registry grows automatically from discovered apply URLs**: every
  connector's apply URLs, the resolver, HN/Reddit posts, SimplifyJobs rows,
  deep-scan research and the weekly `site:` search feed `discoverUrls()`.
  The live run added 67 boards; selfcheck covers each path.
- ⚠️ **Per-source health is available through `/api/sources`**: it's available at
  **`/api/scout/health`** (status, last error, counts, timing, boards, JobSpy
  status). `/api/sources` belongs to A10 (`server/routes/**`), so the one-line
  merge is requested in `docs/build/requests/A01.md`.
- ✅ **A full scout run on a seeded registry yields ≥ 2,000 unique postings, with
  dedupe stats logged**: **5,619 unique tech postings** in one 631-second run,
  with the full dedupe line logged (above). Caveat: with no profile loaded,
  "relevant" means tech-classified, not candidate-matched.

Tests from the brief: a parser test per connector against a recorded payload ✅
(32 connectors; JobSpy through its recorded sidecar output) · ATS detection on
30+ URL samples ✅ (38 positive + 5 negative) · 3 sources collapse to 1 ✅ ·
JobSpy client handles missing Python ✅. `npm run typecheck` ✅ and
`npm run selfcheck` ✅ (all checks pass, A01's 57 included).
